metric_definitions.AP: Official COCO segmentation AP; all model-returned predictions, 100 max detections/image, loader target pixel coordinates.
metric_definitions.precision_recall: Per-image/category descending-score one-to-one best remaining GT matching at mask IoU >= 0.5; score >= 0.5. Crowd-only matches ignored.
metric_definitions.mean_gt_mask_iou: Separate per-image/category descending-score one-to-one best remaining non-crowd GT matching for any positive IoU; score >= 0.5. Sum matched IoUs divided by every non-crowd GT instance, unmatched GT zero.
metric_definitions.unavailable_AP: COCO -1 for absent ground truth is retained in raw stats; reported AP is 0 with availability flag false.

scope: Exactly seven committed corrected test images, at unchanged frozen validation geometry/settings
